Compromise does not mean that I always give something up and I get exactly fuck-all in return, so here are my terms for compromise:

  • Carry licenses are 100% fully reciprocal to every state, territory and DC.
  • There are no more prohibited places aside from the secure area of a jail or prison.
  • The Hughes Amendment is repealed, as is the NFA of 1934. No more tax stamps or registration of machineguns, submachine guns, short barreled rifles and shotguns, AOWs, or suppressors.
  • The requirement to retain 4473 paperwork including the serial number of the firearm purchased is abolished. NICS background checks are performed, but there is no record either at the dealer or otherwise of what was purchased.
  • Private sellers are allowed to use NICS if they so choose to run a check, but private sales are not required to go through an FFL.
  • All magazine size restrictions are lifted
  • The specifications requiring imported guns to be over a certain size are lifted
  • The age to purchase any firearm from an FFL is 18
  • The age to obtain a carry license is also 18
  • Possession of a carry license suffices to demonstrate that one is not a prohibited person for the purposes of firearm ownership
  • If I can own it and carry it in the state in which I reside, I am not an instant criminal for crossing a domestic border from state to state
  • National removal of duty to inform when stopped by a police officer. What I've got is legal and I'm not a criminal, therefore it's none of his concern. If he has reasonable suspicion of a crime based upon specific and clearly articulable facts to search me, he may do so, but I am not required to volunteer any information whatsoever.
